// A route path contains the word `users`. The analyzer counts it as a use — a
// deliberate over-approximation: a false positive costs one namespace, a false
// negative costs a scheduling-dependent flake.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');

test('the admin route responds', async () => {
  expect(db).toBeDefined();
  expect('/api/admin/users').toContain('users');
});
